tools.name: get-audit-log-entries
tools.description: Fetches audit log entries for a LaunchDarkly account. Use the `spec` parameter with format `proj/<projectKey>:env/<envKey>:flag/<flagKey>` to query a specific flag's change history (use `env/*` for all environments). The `before` and `after` parameters accept Unix epoch timestamps in milliseconds for date-range filtering. Returns at most 20 entries per call, ordered newest-first.

tools.name: get-code-references
tools.description: Identifies which repositories have code references to a given flag, helping agents determine if they're operating on the correct repository and understand the scope of cleanup (single vs multi-repo).

tools.name: get-flag-status-across-environments
tools.description: Returns lifecycle status (new, active, inactive, launched) based on actual usage patterns, evaluation counts, and configuration stability. This is the key intelligence for removal readiness assessment.

tools.name: list-feature-flags
tools.description: Retrieves all feature flags within a project, including metadata and targeting rules. Enables AI agents to enumerate existing flags for inspection, configuration analysis, or generating flag usage reports across environments.

tools.name: create-feature-flag
tools.description: Creates a new feature flag within a project. AI agents can use this operation to define feature toggles for controlled rollouts, experimentation, or gated features, automating the flag setup process.

tools.name: get-feature-flag
tools.description: Fetches the full configuration for a specific feature flag, including environments, variations, and targeting rules. Useful for agents auditing or managing specific feature toggles in a detailed, contextual manner.

tools.name: update-feature-flag
tools.description: Updates the configuration of an existing feature flag. Enables agents to change targeting rules, modify variations, or adapt rollout strategies dynamically in response to user behavior or experiment results.

tools.name: delete-feature-flag
tools.description: Removes a feature flag from the project. Used by AI agents to clean up deprecated toggles that are no longer in use, improving system hygiene and maintainability.

tools.name: list-metrics
tools.description: Lists metrics in a project. Use to find metric keys to attach to an experiment.

tools.name: create-metric
tools.description: Creates a metric in a project, for use in experiments and guarded rollouts.

tools.name: get-metric
tools.description: Fetches one metric's configuration.

tools.name: update-metric
tools.description: Updates a metric using a JSON patch.

tools.name: get-environments
tools.description: Identifies which environments exist in a project and determines which are marked as "critical" (production, staging, etc.). Allows agents to programmatically identify critical environments instead of hardcoding assumptions.

tools.name: list-experiments
tools.description: Lists experiments in a project environment, including their current iteration and status.

tools.name: create-experiment
tools.description: Creates an experiment in a project environment, with an initial iteration that sets the hypothesis, flag, treatments, and metrics.

tools.name: get-experiment
tools.description: Fetches one experiment, including its current and past iterations, treatments, and metrics.

tools.name: update-experiment
tools.description: Updates an experiment using semantic patch instructions, such as starting or stopping an iteration, or changing its name or description.

tools.name: create-experiment-iteration
tools.description: Creates a new iteration of an experiment. Start it afterwards with update-experiment.

tools.name: list-experiments-any-environment
tools.description: Lists experiments in a project across all environments. Use to discover experiments before fetching one by environment.

tools.name: get-ai-config-targeting
tools.description: Retrieves the targeting details of a specific AI Config, including individual targets, rules, and rollouts.

tools.name: update-ai-config-targeting
tools.description: Updates the targeting of an existing AI Config.

tools.name: list-ai-configs
tools.description: Retrieves AI configuration settings for a specific project. This endpoint allows agents to access and modify AI-related configurations, ensuring that the AI's behavior aligns with project requirements and user expectations.

tools.name: create-ai-config
tools.description: Creates a new AI Config within a project. Useful for setting up LLM configurations programmatically.

tools.name: delete-ai-config
tools.description: Deletes an AI Config and its associated variations. Intended for cleanup or deprecation workflows.

tools.name: get-ai-config
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific AI Config, including variations and model settings.

tools.name: update-ai-config
tools.description: Updates metadata or configuration of an existing AI Config.

tools.name: create-ai-config-variation
tools.description: Adds a new variation to an AI Config, supporting experimentation or multi-model strategies.

tools.name: delete-ai-config-variation
tools.description: Deletes an AI Config variation.

tools.name: get-ai-config-variation
tools.description: Retrieves an AI configuration variation.

tools.name: update-ai-config-variation
tools.description: Updates a specific variation within an AI Config. Enables fine-tuned control of model behavior.
